references.title: DWDS: Schoner
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung for der Schoner, 'Segelschiff mit mehreren Masten'; the Etymologie gives a borrowing (2nd half of the 18th c.) from English schooner

notes.rationale: The sailing ship, der Schoner, is a loan from English schooner with no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word with no Constituents: the Root schoner and the zero ending (ADR 0050: a loan blended abroad has none; ADR 0051). der Schoner, a protective cover, splits schonen + -er (ADR 0050: the Reading owns the split).
